scopeNote: No source is permitted to use Last-Known-Good data unless it explicitly opts into a bounded stale-data policy. Mutation requests are never automatically retried. Version-skew recovery updates only reliability session state and reloads the document at most once per observed deployment transition; Supabase/auth persistent session storage is not cleared.
implementationBoundary: Global reliability is event-driven and presentation-only. Feature remount preserves persistent auth/session state. Generic retries are GET/HEAD-only. LKG is deny-by-default and requires explicit bounded source opt-in.
